name: Lexa Lyu
description: Yijian "Lexa" Lyu is a PhD researcher in Religious Studies at the University of Iowa. Her work has been featured at venues including Harvard University, Peking University, and the World Bank, where her research on Islamic digital finance received an Outstanding Paper Award. She received a fellowship at the Mercatus Center and support from the Institute for Humane Studies, with additional recognition from a National Science Foundation grant through the Society for Social Studies of Science (4S).
